home_prompt: Create original Japanese homepage design proposal for ジンギスカンロッジ, 山形県山形市 蔵王温泉. Exact1536x864 16:9 landscape canvas. Desktop webpage left plus narrow mobile webpage right. Warm dark chocolate, ivory, muted amber. Elegant readable Japanese typography and text-only brand no copied sheep logo. Main headline「蔵王で味わう、ジンギスカン。」 Original illustrative appetizing grilled lamb with vegetables on ridged Japanese barbecue pan; no real shop or actual menu portions implied. Cards「お食事」「ご宿泊」「アクセス」. MAIN IMPROVEMENT business information and contact blocks fit screen width, mobile vertically stacked wrapped text. Prominent contact block「ご予約・お問い合わせ」「023-694-9546」「j-mail@jingiss68.com」each on separate line. Button「営業日を確認する」. Small explicit notice「11月16日〜12月14日は休業予定です。12月15日より営業開始予定。」Both mobile and desktop contact visible readable. No prices, origin superlatives, rating, invented booking forms, availability guarantees. Visible「非公式デザイン案」「写真はイメージです」. Polished clean website, not a flyer. No reference to other businesses.
inquiry_prompt: Create a separate contact guidance page for ジンギスカンロッジ using provided homepage only as style reference. Exact1536x864 16:9 landscape; large desktop left and narrow mobile right. Matching chocolate/ivory/amber elegant Japanese. Heading「ご予約・お問い合わせ」. Main improvement mobile contact and business information vertically stacked fitting width, no clipping. Large stacked cards「お電話でのお問い合わせ」「023-694-9546」 and「メールでのお問い合わせ」「j-mail@jingiss68.com」, then button「Rettyネット予約」, button「営業日を確認する」. Address「山形県山形市蔵王温泉上ノ代758-2」. Clear notice both views「11月16日〜12月14日は休業予定です。12月15日より営業開始予定。」No new forms, personal data, reservation confirmation, response time or price claims. Airy readable typography with generous spacing. No photos needed; subtle mountain line drawing backdrop. Footer「非公式デザイン案」. Fully readable telephone and email on mobile.
review: Company, contact, planned closure, mobile stacking, unofficial/photo labels visually verified.
